nodes.text: You carry the blessing, so I'll ask you a keeping. The old dead are walking where lamps used to burn — the tower on the first climb, after dark, and deeper places besides. They've stopped passing the light along.

Ember essence, six measures, for the relighting. The world carries fire in odd pockets — goblin camps, the kobold digs, road crews who robbed it off someone else. The flame doesn't ask where its kindling slept.

choices.text: Rest for them, embers for you.

nodes.text: The dark is large, and we pass the light along. Go gently.
Then keep your own lamp filled. That's a keeping too.
